principle: Carry unwind risk, structural JGB stress, capital repatriation and persistent yen weakness are separate questions. Never infer an unwind from JGB 10Y 3% alone.

risk_colour.orange: active unwind warning with yen-strength plus corroborating funding or volatility pressure
risk_colour.red: yen-strength shock plus funding pressure plus volatility/cross-asset deleveraging confirmation

fast_unwind_factors: Japan 2Y JGB as a short-rate proxy
structural_factors: Japan 10Y JGB 3% as a structural/fiscal boundary, not an automatic unwind trigger
consecutive official JGB 10Y closes at or above 3%
Japan MOF outward equity flows separated from outward long-term debt flows
Japan MOF 2-week and year-to-date outward long-term debt flows for repatriation pressure
10Y and 30Y JGB auction bid-to-cover ratios and yield tails versus prior auctions

source_priority.positioning: CFTC Traders in Financial Futures - Futures Only current report
source_priority.outward_flows: Japan MOF International Transactions in Securities weekly historical CSV; equities and long-term debt are parsed separately
source_priority.jgb_auctions: Japan MOF official 10-year and 30-year auction result pages
source_priority.intraday_fx: Yahoo query1/query2 cross-check; may be delayed

not_yet_scored: BOJ OIS hike probability until a reliable automated market source is locked
bank/overseas yen funding balances until the exact BOJ/BIS official series used by market commentary is identified

alert_policy.cadence: every 15 minutes, GitHub schedule may start late
realert_on: JGB 10Y entering or leaving the 3% structural boundary
JGB 10Y remaining at or above 3% for at least two official business-day closes
new Japan MOF outward-flow release when risk is active or long-term-debt direction changes
